result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues relating to text truncation and horizontal scroll indicators.

issues.description: The name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is abruptly clipped at the edge of the card without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement text-overflow: ellipsis for truncated restaurant names.

issues.description: The category list at the top shows a very small sliver of the next item on the right edge, which looks accidental.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal spacing so the cut-off item is more recognizable as a scroll indicator.
